title: Teleport+
description: A lightweight Paper 1.21 plugin that adds player teleport requests, and warp system with cooldowns.
body:
Teleport+ is a lightweight and feature-rich teleportation plugin for Paper 1.21 servers. It provides a comprehensive system for player teleportation and warp management with advanced cooldown controls and OP-only features.

## Features:

## Player Teleportation:

・/tpa <player> - Request to teleport to another player

・/tpaccept - Accept incoming teleport requests

・/tpcancel - Cancel your pending teleport

・/tp <player> - Instant teleport to player (OP only)

・/tphere <player> - Teleport a player to you (OP only)

・Cooldown system for /tpa requests (configurable per target)

・Teleport delay after acceptance with movement cancellation

・Clickable cancel button in chat during countdown

## Warp System:

・/warp - List all available warps

・/warp create <name> [OP] - Create a warp (OP-only warp teleport)

・/warp delete <name> - Delete a warp

・/warp cooldown <name> <time> - Set cooldown for a warp

・/warp <name> - Teleport to a warp

・Cross-dimension support (Overworld, Nether, End)

・OP-only warps with restricted access

## Administration:

・/tp working <on/off> - Globally enable/disable player teleportation

・/warp working <on/off> - Globally enable/disable warp system

・/tp enable/disable <player> - Allow/block teleport requests to specific players

・/tpa cooldown <time> - Set global cooldown for teleport requests

・/tpaccept cooldown <time> - Set delay before teleport after acceptance

## Time Format:

・10s - 10 seconds

・5m - 5 minutes

・2h - 2 hours

・1d - 1 day

## Permissions:

・teleportplus.tpa - Use /tpa command

・teleportplus.tpaccept - Use /tpaccept command

・teleportplus.tpcancel - Use /tpcancel command

・teleportplus.warp.use - Use warps

・teleportplus.warp.create - Create warps

・teleportplus.warp.delete - Delete warps

・teleportplus.warp.cooldown - Set warp cooldowns

・teleportplus.tp.global - Use OP teleport commands

・teleportplus.tp.working - Toggle global teleport

・teleportplus.tp.toggle - Enable/disable player teleport access

・teleportplus.tp.cooldown - Set /tpa cooldown

・teleportplus.tpaccept.cooldown - Set teleport delay

## Compatibility:

・Paper 1.21 - 1.21.11

・Purpur 1.21 - 1.21.11

・Spigot 1.21 - 1.21.11

・Folia (experimental)

## Installation:

・Download the JAR file

・Place it in your server's plugins folder

・Restart your server

・Configure in plugins/TeleportPlus/config.yml

Author: mesk
Version: 1.1.0
Requirements: Java 21, Paper 1.21+
